description.en: Official plugin collection for DeepSeek Harness: desktop model access, provider quota, extra sandbox roots, and session archiving.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方插件集：桌面端模型接入、提供商额度显示、沙盒额外可写目录、归档会话管理。

description.en: Bring models offered by desktop agents into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration, per-model thinking effort, and billing rate at a glance.
description.zh: 把桌面端 Agent 提供的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：零配置复用登录态、逐模型思考强度、模型选择器直接显示计费倍率。

description.en: Show the current LLM provider remaining quota in the composer dock, with a generic querier registry any provider plugin can extend.
description.zh: 在对话输入区底栏显示当前提供商的剩余额度，并带一个任何 provider 插件都能扩展的通用查询器注册表。

title.zh: 沙盒额外允许写入目录

description.en: Extra writable roots for the workspace-write sandbox across Seatbelt, bwrap and Landlock profiles, plus the filesystem fence.
description.zh: 为 workspace-write 沙盒增加额外可写目录：同时覆盖 Seatbelt / bwrap / Landlock 与文件系统围栏，并带设置页。

description.en: Browse archived sessions, inspect their content, and batch restore or permanently delete them from the sidebar.
description.zh: 浏览归档会话、查看会话内容，并从侧边栏批量恢复或彻底删除。
